\documentclass{standalone}
\usepackage{pgfplots}
\newcommand{\point}[2]{\pgfextractx{\dimen0}{\pgfpointanchor{#1}{#2}}\pgfextracty{\dimen2}{\pgfpointanchor{#1}{#2}}\typeout{POINT #1.#2: \the\dimen0,\the\dimen2}}
\begin{document}
\setbox0=\hbox{x}\typeout{BOX x: \the\wd0,\the\ht0,\the\dp0}
\setbox0=\hbox{y}\typeout{BOX y: \the\wd0,\the\ht0,\the\dp0}
\setbox0=\hbox{office AV}\typeout{BOX regular10: \the\wd0,\the\ht0,\the\dp0}
\setbox0=\hbox{\footnotesize office AV}\typeout{BOX regular8: \the\wd0,\the\ht0,\the\dp0}
\setbox0=\hbox{\large office AV}\typeout{BOX regular12: \the\wd0,\the\ht0,\the\dp0}
\setbox0=\hbox{\bfseries office AV}\typeout{BOX bold10: \the\wd0,\the\ht0,\the\dp0}
\begin{tikzpicture}
\begin{axis}[axis x line=middle,axis y line=middle,
  xmin=-2,xmax=2,ymin=-1,ymax=2,width=16cm,height=8cm,
  tick align=outside,enlargelimits=false,xlabel=x,ylabel=y,
  xlabel style={name=xlabel},ylabel style={name=ylabel}]
\addplot coordinates {(-2,-1)(2,2)};
\end{axis}
\point{current axis}{origin}
\point{current axis}{right of origin}\point{current axis}{above origin}
\point{xlabel}{center}\point{xlabel}{text}
\point{ylabel}{center}\point{ylabel}{text}
\point{xlabel}{south east}\point{ylabel}{north west}
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document}
